name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and manages Nginx with three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, static site content, TLS and security settings, Fail2ban, UFW, SSH hardening, and kernel networking parameters.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis password authentication, logging, service enablement, and related configuration settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with a virtual environment, configures its database and environment, and manages a systemd Uvicorn service.
